title.ko: Dear Sir or Madam · I am writing to · I would be grateful if · Yours faithfully
title.en: Dear Sir or Madam · I am writing to · I would be grateful if · Yours faithfully

explain.ko: 공식 편지와 지원서는 정해진 형식과 정중한 표현을 씁니다. 받는 사람의 이름을 모르면 Dear Sir or Madam으로 시작해 Yours faithfully로, 이름을 알면 Dear Mr/Ms …로 시작해 Yours sincerely로 끝냅니다. 첫 문장에서 I am writing to + 동사원형(enquire/apply)이나 in response to …로 목적을 밝힙니다. 요청은 I would be grateful if you could …, 첨부는 I enclose …를 씁니다. 줄임말과 구어체는 쓰지 않으며 마지막에는 I look forward to your reply로 맺습니다.
explain.en: Formal letters and applications follow a fixed layout and polite wording. If you don't know the name, begin Dear Sir or Madam and end Yours faithfully; if you know it, begin Dear Mr/Ms … and end Yours sincerely. State your purpose in the first sentence: I am writing to + verb (enquire/apply) or in response to …. Request with I would be grateful if you could …, and mention attachments with I enclose …. Avoid contractions and slang, and finish with I look forward to your reply.

lines.t: How do I begin a formal letter?
How do I mention my CV?
How should I write an application letter?
Begin with 'Dear Sir or Madam' and say you are responding to the advertisement.
Describe your experience and say you enclose your CV. End with 'Yours faithfully'.
